## Definition of Done

- [ ] All acceptance criteria on the card are tested
- [ ] Tests are written and the full test suite is green
- [ ] Lint passes
- [ ] No secrets, passwords, OTP codes or CV text in code or logs
- [ ] README and API docs are updated
- [ ] Verified on the shared dev environment

## Reviewer

One reviewer approves and merges. Nobody merges their own pull request.
